stemMd: Which retention policy most directly combines the two proposals?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Keep every document without selection or documentation.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Retain informal complaints but discard all major decision records.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Preserve major decision records, retain systematically chosen samples of ordinary transactions, and document all selection rules.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Preserve only ceremonial announcements and delete the selection schedule.

explanationMd: The combined policy retains the first author's decision records and transparency while including the second's clear-method samples of routine encounters. It does not require preserving everything.

distractorRationale.d: This excludes ordinary transactions and loses transparency.
distractorRationale.a: Both authors regard total preservation as infeasible.
distractorRationale.b: Both authors regard formal decisions as important.
